source_id: airbus-ac-a320-2026-07, FIGURE-2-2-0-991-009-A01 sheet 2 of 2 (pdf p49); turning radii FIGURE-4-3-0-991-003-A01 (pdf p196), type 1 turn, 75 deg max steering, 71.9 deg effective
origin: nose tip, x aft, y right
outline_note: Right half, nose (0,0) round the wing and tail to the tail-cone tip on the centreline; mirror y for the left half. Traced by research/work/aircraft/trace.js: scale from the length dimension only, so the span is an independent check (check.js). Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.05 m.
engines_note: Not traced: nacelle position labels on the sheet were not mapped to their dimensions. Gap.
gear_derivation: main gear x = sqrt(R5^2 - Y^2) = sqrt(18.2^2 - 4.1^2); nose gear x = main gear x - wheelbase 12.64. Check: sqrt(R3^2 - Y^2) = 12.76 vs wheelbase 12.64 (R3 is to the tyre's outside face, so a few tenths over is expected).
pivot_note: Tiller steering turns the aircraft about a point on the main-gear axle line (x = main_gear.x), offset sideways to the turn centre. Rotate the drawing about (main_gear.x, 0) for a heading change on the spot; a taxi turn's centre is at (main_gear.x, +-Y) with Y >= the table's minimum.
